Game Overview

In Blop, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a popping frenzy with Blop, where bubbles drift across a vibrant turquoise screen. Your mission: pop as many floating bubbles as possible within 20 seconds. Each pop fuels your score while varying bubble sizes and speeds test your reflexes. Addictive yet deceptively simple—can you beat your best score?
